svg.aria-label: Plunder by Port and Year — Bar diagram
svg.style: background: rgb(236, 239, 244); font-family: Inter, system-ui, Avenir, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;
svg.desc: Bar chart of 3 series, Gold, Silver and Spices, for 8 categories; values range from 8 to 52.
